en.headline: Hong Kong Ballet premieres Dunhuang: In Search of Light at Cultural Centre
en.dek: The new work, inspired by Mogao Caves and Hermann Hesse’s Siddhartha, runs until Sunday with performances at 2:30pm and 7:30pm today.
body: Hong Kong Ballet is presenting the world premiere of Dunhuang: In Search of Light at the Grand Theatre of the Hong Kong Cultural Centre from 16 to 18 October.

Created by resident choreographers Hu Song Wei Ricky and Mai Jingwen, the production draws on the visual world of the Dunhuang caves and Hermann Hesse’s novel Siddhartha. It marks the company’s first collaboration with the Dunhuang Academy.

Tickets range from HK$280 to HK$1,380. Performances last about 1 hour 50 minutes including an intermission and are suitable for ages 6 and above. Remaining shows are at 2:30pm and 7:30pm on Saturday and Sunday.

zh.headline: 香港芭蕾舞團世界首演《敦煌：溯光行》於文化中心上演
zh.dek: 由胡頌威及麥靜雯編舞，靈感來自敦煌壁畫及赫塞《流浪者之歌》，今明兩日下午及晚上仍有演出。
body: 作品由駐團編舞胡頌威及麥靜雯創作，以敦煌莫高窟視覺元素及赫塞小說《流浪者之歌》為靈感，並首次與敦煌研究院合作。
香港芭蕾舞團於香港文化中心大劇院呈獻原創作品《敦煌：溯光行》世界首演，演出日期為10月16日至18日。
票價由280元至1380元，演出約1小時50分鐘（包括中場），適合6歲或以上。今日及明日下午2時30分及晚上7時30分仍有場次。
